findings: ZIP 68718 (Bloomfield) has 12 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.

Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68718 (Bloomfield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
